black-olive.$description: Black Olive — Page background, hero canvas, primary text on light sections — the dominant surface that makes the yellow accent feel like lit signage

forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Headings, body text, list dividers, link color — the deep green gives the dark-mode typography a botanical, not corporate, character

lemon-zest.$description: Lemon Zest — Filled CTA buttons, large display headlines, accent links, highlight washes — the only chromatic note in the system, used sparingly to ignite dark sections

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Light section backgrounds, card surfaces, off-white content panels — a paper-stock warmth that softens the dark hero without going clinical

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Hairline dividers, subtle borders, muted accents — a desaturated green-gray that holds the system together without competing with the two brand greens

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Icon strokes, button borders, negative-space punctuation inside the dark canvas

venuscom.$description: Primary typeface across all UI — the signature choice is positive tracking that scales with size (0.06em at 75px down to 0.04em at body), giving display lines a wide-set, almost neon-sign feel and keeping small body text compact

font-awesome-6-free.$description: Icon system — solid-fill glyphs inheriting the wide letter-spacing for UI micro-elements (arrows, social marks)

font-awesome-6-brands.$description: Brand/social icons rendered larger for footer or badge contexts

times.$description: Times — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

helvetica.$description: Helvetica — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

freesans.$description: FreeSans — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
